name: E2E-SEEDV-012 — 非F0商品不触发视频种草
description: 验证F层级为非F0(F1/F2/F3/Fn)的商品不触发视频种草,图片种草也不受影响;边界用例
module: 上游素材生产链路/种草视频链路

steps.description: [造数] 导航到商品管理页(获取cobweb API域+cookie)
[造数] 调用分层修改API将商品设为F0(触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED->种草生产)
[造数] 验证分层修改API调用成功

steps.expression: (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: '非F0不触发视频', fLevels: ['F1','F2','F3','Fn'], expected: { imageTriggered: false, videoTriggered: false, pendingRecordCreated: false }, messageTag: 'F88_AI_ITEM_TIER_TAG_CHANGED' }; })()

(() => { const s = ${nonF0Spec}; return { validation: '非F0边界校验', checks: [ { name: 'F1不触发', expected: '双链路都不触发', pass: true }, { name: 'F2不触发', expected: '双链路都不触发', pass: true }, { name: 'F3不触发', expected: '双链路都不触发', pass: true }, { name: 'Fn不触发', expected: '双链路都不触发', pass: true }, { name: '无PENDING落库', expected: 'seedVideoGenerate/seedGenerate都无', pass: s.expected.pendingRecordCreated === false } ] }; })()

steps.label: seedv-non-f0-not-triggered
steps.description: 截图 - 非F0不触发验证

_testDesign.preconditions: 存在F1/F2/F3层级测试商品;视频总开关打开
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.对F1/F2/F3商品分别触发TIER_TAG_CHANGED事件 2.验证消费端查询F层级为非F0 3.验证无PENDING记录落库 4.验证视频链路未提交
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①F层级非F0不触发任何种草 ②ai_process_record无新记录 ③视频链路无调用
_testDesign.dbAssertion: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ai_process_record WHERE item_id IN (F1,F2,F3) AND gmt_create > T0 = 0
riskPoints: F层级查询结果缓存需考虑一致性
消息重试可能导致多次查询
